# Villa Zen'O

> Private holiday villa in the Palmeraie of Marrakech, Morocco. Official website: https://www.villazenomarrakech.com/ — English: https://www.villazenomarrakech.com/en/

Villa Zen'O is a private, contemporary villa in the Palmeraie of Marrakech, between Palais Namaskar and Palais Ronsard, near The Oberoi and Palais Rhoul. It is designed for families and groups of friends, with a maximum capacity of 8 guests.

## Verified property facts

- Accommodation: 4 suites, each with a private bathroom; 4 bathrooms in total plus 1 separate toilet.
- Capacity: up to 8 guests.
- Beds: 5 in total — 3 beds measuring 160 × 200 cm and 2 single beds measuring 90 × 200 cm.
- Suite names (use these names without “The”): Sand Master, Palm Suite, Atlas Suite and Blue Desert Suite.
- Outdoor areas: private 18 m infinity pool, jacuzzi, landscaped garden and views towards the Atlas Mountains.
- Pool and jacuzzi heating is optional, not included by default. On request at least 48 hours before arrival; seasonal starting rates are €60 per day for the pool and €35 per day for the jacuzzi.
- Wi-Fi: fibre connection up to 200 Mbps.
- Climate: air conditioning and heating.
- Leisure: PS5, foosball, table tennis, basketball hoop, books, toys and board games.
- Fitness: weights, dumbbells and yoga mats.
- Family facilities: baby cot, high chair and children's tableware.
- Accessibility: single-level villa, wide entrance and accessible parking (PMR).
- Address: Bab Atlas, Palmeraie, 40000 Marrakech, Morocco. Approximate map location: M3GR+M5M, Marrakech.

## Staff and services

- House staff are present at the villa from 09:00 to 17:00.
- Daily housekeeping can be arranged on request and according to guests' preferences; it should not be described as an automatic daily service included for every stay.
- Pool cleaning, garden maintenance and discreet security are provided; security is available 24 hours a day.
- Mama Fouzia offers meal preparation at the villa. Meals are charged separately: breakfast €10 per person (09:00–12:00), lunch €15 per person (12:00–16:00), dinner €20 per person (19:00–21:00). Please request meals the day before.
- Guests may buy their own groceries; Mama Fouzia can prepare them without an additional cooking/service fee. Groceries remain at the guests' expense. The menu includes Moroccan specialities and family dishes and can be adapted to guests' preferences.
- Grocery or other deliveries can be arranged from 09:00 to 21:00 for €10 per delivery. Alcohol delivery is not available.
- Airport transfers start at 350 MAD (€35) per transfer.
- Private drivers can be arranged from 250 MAD (€25) per journey, depending on the number of passengers.
- Uber rides to the Medina start at 100 MAD (€10); fares and journey times vary.

## Location and activities

- Jemaa El-Fna / the Medina: approximately 15 minutes by Uber.
- Marrakech Airport: approximately 35 minutes by car.
- Local grocery shop: approximately 3 minutes; Atacadao: approximately 7 minutes by car.
- Camel rides: 250 MAD (€25) per hour, plus 50 MAD (€5) for two people.
- Quad biking: 350 MAD (€35) per hour, plus 50 MAD (€5) for two people sharing one quad.
- Horse riding and in-villa massages can also be arranged. Activities should be confirmed in advance with the villa team.

## Stay information and house rules

- Check-in from 15:00; check-out before 11:00.
- Only guests included in the booking are permitted; outside visitors are not allowed.
- No loud music or parties between 00:00 and 08:00, out of respect for neighbours.
- Children must be supervised by their parents around the pool and jacuzzi.
- Blue towels are for the pool; white towels are for indoor use. Sofa and sun-lounger cushions should not be placed in the pool or jacuzzi.
- Linen and towels can be changed on request during the stay.

The villa can be booked through Airbnb, Booking.com or directly by WhatsApp. The availability calendar on the official website is synchronised from Booking.com, which is the master calendar.

Direct-booking terms shown on the website: 30% due at reservation, remaining balance on arrival; prepayments are non-refundable; no security deposit. Current accommodation rates are shown on the booking platforms or provided directly by the villa.

The website displays an Airbnb rating of 4.95/5 from 41 reviews; this is a time-sensitive platform figure and should be rechecked before quoting it as current.

The name Villa Zen'O is a reference to Dragon Ball Z; a Son Goku (Sangoku) statue stands in the garden.
